answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 40773 Country: Pakistan Title: Why zakah is not given to a Syyid family Question: Why zakah is not given to a Syyid family although, they accept sadqah etc. Please, reply in detail. Answer ID: 40773 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1296/1296/M=1433) It is not lawful for a Sayyid to take zakah and wajib sadaqah as well as it is unlawful for a person to give to him. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) has prohibited it and said that zakah is the filth of people hence it is not halal for Sadat (Sayyid). إن الصدقة محرمة على بني هاشم (حديث) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
